name: pipeline-flow
title: Pipeline Flow
description: Horizontal chain of stage boxes linked by animated marching-ants arrows.
question: What are the stages of this process, and in what order does work flow?
whenToUse: Explaining a linear multi-step process (ETL, CI, review pipeline) where order matters more than metrics.
antiUse: Not for branching/looping flows or quantitative comparison between stages — no values are encoded.
props: steps: {name, desc}[] ordered stages; accent?: string arrow color (default seriesColor(0))
